curator: YonkouJean PGO infographic — Great League teams recommended/used by top GBL players, GBL Season 27 (Aug 2026)
extraction: Orchestrator read team images supplied by Jaxon (2026-08-21). Members are pvpoke speciesIds ('_shadow' suffix = shadow form, matching vendor training-preset convention). Entries with uncertain:true carry a note about the flagged read — advisory for humans; loaders treat all entries alike and must skip-with-warning any speciesId that fails to resolve, dropping a team whole if ANY member fails (2 mons isn't a team). Core-breaker strips in the YonkouJean images are the teams' counters, deliberately NOT included. Teams with tier:'off-meta' come from a second batch (Japanese Nature-Cup party infographics + player battle-party screenshots + one English player party): Jaxon wants them in the opponent pool for surface diversity, at reduced sampling weight vs the untagged (meta) teams. JP entries were identified primarily from printed katakana names (high confidence); in-game screenshots use a nickname-of-base-stage pattern resolved via CP feasibility (e.g. 'Frillish' at CP 1498 = Jellicent, pink female sprite). Entries id-prefixed 'yasseraleed-' are a third batch (GOALS T26, 2026-08-21): 13 untagged (meta) teams visually transcribed from stream screenshots by GBL streamer Yasser Aleed (twitch.tv/YasserAleed, YouTube aleed_yasser, Discord /thecoolkidz), supplied by Jaxon; where an on-screen team-builder card was visible its text is authoritative over a visual read (recorded in each team's 'notes'), and species-level shadow status is recorded only where the stream explicitly showed it (a shiny/cosmetic render is never treated as shadow).
